summary: Isabella Bank Corp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing the mailing of election materials and the October 23, 2026 election deadline in its proposed merger with Grand River Commerce (OTCQX: GNRV). Grand River holders may elect cash or Isabella common stock, or a combination, subject to adjustment and proration; the cash election pool is a stated $18,262,391 aggregate. Record date was September 24, 2026, with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust as election agent. The merger remains subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions, targeted for fourth quarter 2026. Watch regulatory approval timing, election over-subscription proration and the extendable election deadline.
